commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
inventory = json.loads(Path('\\''project/recovery-inventory.json'\\'').read_text())
record = bytes.fromhex(inventory['\\''retained_sample'\\'']['\\''value_hex'\\''])
payload = record[5:]
position = 0
def avro_long():
    global position
    value = shift = 0
    while True:
        byte = payload[position]
        position += 1
        value |= (byte & 127) << shift
        if not byte & 128:
            return (value >> 1) "'^ -(value & 1)
        shift += 7
def avro_string():
    global position
    length = avro_long()
    assert length >= 0
    result = payload[position:position + length].decode('"'\\''utf-8'\\'')
    position += length
    return result
account = avro_string()
currency = avro_string()
amount = avro_long()
assert position == len(payload)
ledger = inventory['\\''retained_sample'\\'']['\\''source_ledger'\\'']
assert (account, currency, amount) == (ledger['\\''account'\\''], ledger['\\''currency'\\''], ledger['\\''amount_minor'\\''])
print(json.dumps({'\\''analysis'\\'': '\\''offline parsing of supplied sample using supplied source schema; no registry or client used'\\'', '\\''magic_byte'\\'': record[0], '\\''writer_id_big_endian'\\'': int.from_bytes(record[1:5], '\\''big'\\''), '\\''account'\\'': account, '\\''currency'\\'': currency, '\\''amount_in_source_cents'\\'': amount, '\\''expected_USD'\\'': ledger['\\''amount_decimal'\\''], '\\''payload_bytes_consumed'\\'': position, '\\''payload_bytes_total'\\'': len(payload)}))'"
